conbody.p: Intelligent Speed Limit Assist uses information from detected road signs and navigation system data to inform you of the posted speed limit or additional sign and help you maintain it. However, when navigation is not available, the system operates based on information recognized from road signs.

li.p: Intelligent Speed Limit Assist may not operate properly if you use it in other countries.
If your vehicle has a navigation system, the system needs regular updates for Intelligent Speed Limit Assist to operate properly.
